column1: # Expected results of today's firmware in the D12 scenario + invariant suite
#   status xfail     = today's code fails this invariant here; the rule column
#                      names the root cause (a firmware rework row). The test
#                      fails when such a row starts to PASS: flip (delete) it
#                      in the PR that fixes the cause.
#   status limit=<us> = I7: today's scrape-walk duration on a healthy bus. A
#                      slower walk fails (the owner's hard rule); a faster one
#                      passes -- lower the limit in the PR that speeds it up.
# Regenerate with `test_sim_invariants --emit`, then review every changed row.
# I7 limits re-based in wave E1 (planterm, roll-call rework): the D12 limits were measured with the pGD
#   locked out (single-terminal repaints). With both terminals served every display frame is mirrored
#   (20' then 1F', R-DI/A4), ~+150 ms per step. OWNER DECISION pending (scrape walk never slower).
